name: falcon-tests
description: Falcon Campus OS — Phase A testing infrastructure

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:e2e
scripts.coverage: npm run test:unit -- --coverage && npm run test:integration -- --coverage && node scripts/verify-backend-coverage.cjs
scripts.test:ci: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run lint:frontend:tests && npm run coverage && npm run test:frontend:cov && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck:backend && npm run typecheck:frontend
scripts.lint:full: npm run lint && cd ../backend && npm run lint && cd ../frontend && npm run lint
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
